steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Rank. Each escalation is placed by whether its cause, owner and outcome are recorded.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

outcome.verdict: 1 cause repeats three times this week

findings.title: Cause category repeated three times this week
findings.fix: Fix the cause, not the case

outcome.notChecked: The customer's view of the outcome.

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.
Summary: 3 findings (1 high, 1 medium, 1 low).
[high] esc-0603.md:12  Cause category repeated three times this week.
       Fix: Fix the cause, not the case.
[medium] esc-0602.md:19  Escalation with no owner.
       Fix: Assign an owner.
[low] esc-0605.md:26  Escalation with no outcome.
       Fix: Record the outcome.
Not checked: The customer's view of the outcome.
pros: Checks an escalation with no cause, no owner or no outcome, and a cause category that appears three or more times in the week.
cons: Not checked: The customer's view of the outcome.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-cs-escalation-review skill on the records for this review.
